name: Persistent Identifiers Field Set
description: Creates persistent identifiers of different types on content.
project_description:
Persistent Identifier Field Set Module 
 Persistent identifier field set module provides a field that allows users to enter/create a persistent id (DOI, ARK, Handle, UUID) for their work.

 Set up persistent identifier minters 
 If you want to mint a new persistent id, you will need to set up the minters first. Please click Help -> Persistent Identifiers Field Set Module -> Persistent id field set settings and fill up the configuration forms and click "Save configuration".
